# Making Variables Factor
```{r}
MegaAnalysisMaster$Gender <- as.factor(MegaAnalysisMaster$Gender)
MegaAnalysisMaster$Has_Phone <- as.factor(MegaAnalysisMaster$Has_Phone)

MegaAnalysisMaster$Gender <- recode_factor(MegaAnalysisMaster$Gender, `0` = "Female", `1` = "Male")
MegaAnalysisMaster$Has_Phone<- recode_factor(MegaAnalysisMaster$Has_Phone, `0` = "No Phone", `1` = "Phone")

MegaAnalysisMaster$ParadigmsCombined_Factor <- recode_factor(MegaAnalysisMaster$ParadigmsCombined, `1` = "Tech Directions", `2` = "Tech Restraunt", `3` = "Waiting Alone", `4` = "Waiting Together", `5` = "Parent Study", `6` = "Lunch Study")

MegaAnalysisMasterGraphs <- subset(MegaAnalysisMaster, Gender == "Female" | Gender == "Male")

MegaAnalysisMasterGraphs <- subset(MegaAnalysisMasterGraphs, Has_Phone == "No Phone"|  Has_Phone == "Phone")


```

# PreRegistered Models
We are using a form of stepwise regression where we are including in more variables with each iterated analysis. 

Step 1:
Phone/No Phone

Step 2:
Phone/No Phone 
Gender
Age
Ethnicity

Step 3:
Phone/No Phone
Gender + Interaction between Gender and Phone/No Phone 
Age 
Ethnicity

Step 4:
Phone/No Phone 
Gender + Interaction between Gender and Phone/No Phone 
Age
Ethnicity
Phone Dependence
How Phone was Used

Step 5a:
Phone/No Phone 
Gender + Interaction between Gender and Phone/No Phone 
Age
Ethnicity
Phone Dependence + Interaction between Gender and Phone/No Phone 
How Phone was Used

Step 5b:
Phone/No Phone 
Gender  + Interaction between Gender and Phone/No Phone 
Age
Ethnicity
Phone Dependence + Interaction between Gender and Phone/No Phone 
How Phone was Used  + Interaction between Gender and Phone/No Phone 

# Affect Valence
## Model 1
```{r}
contrasts(MegaAnalysisMaster$ParadigmsCombined_Factor) = contr.sum(6)

OrigEmoInitial <- lm(Emotional_Valance_Std ~ Has_Phone, MegaAnalysisMaster)
summary(OrigEmoInitial)
```


## Model 2
### w/ Ethnicity
```{r}

OrigEmoInitial2 <- lm(Emotional_Valance_Std ~ Has_Phone + Gender + Age + IsOtherRace + IsMultiRacial + IsMiddleEastern + IsHispanic + IsFirstNation + IsAsian + IsBlack, MegaAnalysisMaster)
summary(OrigEmoInitial2)
```

 
### w/o Ethnicity
```{r}
OrigEmoInitial2.5 <- lm(Emotional_Valance_Std ~ Has_Phone + Gender + Age, MegaAnalysisMaster)
summary(OrigEmoInitial2.5)
```

## Model 3 
### w/ Ethnicity
```{r}
OrigEmoInitial3 <- lm(Emotional_Valance_Std ~ Has_Phone * Gender + Age + IsOtherRace + IsMultiRacial + IsMiddleEastern + IsHispanic + IsFirstNation + IsAsian + IsBlack, MegaAnalysisMaster)
summary(OrigEmoInitial3)
```


### w/o Ethnicity
```{r}
OrigEmoInitial3.5 <- lm(Emotional_Valance_Std ~ Has_Phone * Gender + Age, MegaAnalysisMaster)
summary(OrigEmoInitial3.5)
```

## Model 4
### w/ Ethnicity
```{r}
OrigEmoInitial4 <- lm(Emotional_Valance_Std ~ Has_Phone * Gender + Age + IsOtherRace + IsMultiRacial + IsMiddleEastern + IsHispanic + IsFirstNation + IsAsian + IsBlack + PhoneDependence_Std, MegaAnalysisMaster)
summary(OrigEmoInitial4)
```

### w/o Ethnicity
```{r}
OrigEmoInitial4.5 <- lm(Emotional_Valance_Std ~ Has_Phone * Gender + Age + PhoneDependence_Std, MegaAnalysisMaster)
summary(OrigEmoInitial4.5)
```


## Model 5a
### w/ Ethnicity
```{r}
OrigEmoInitial5a <- lm(Emotional_Valance_Std ~ Has_Phone * Gender + Age + IsOtherRace + IsMultiRacial + IsMiddleEastern + IsHispanic + IsFirstNation + IsAsian + IsBlack + Has_Phone * Gender * PhoneDependence_Std, MegaAnalysisMaster)
summary(OrigEmoInitial5a)
```


### w/o Ethnicity
```{r}
OrigEmoInitial5a.5 <- lm(Emotional_Valance_Std ~ Has_Phone * Gender + Age + Has_Phone * Gender * PhoneDependence_Std, MegaAnalysisMaster)
summary(OrigEmoInitial5a.5)
```


## Combined Table
```{r}
OrigEmoModels <- list(OrigEmoInitial, OrigEmoInitial2, OrigEmoInitial3, OrigEmoInitial4, OrigEmoInitial5a
)
```


```{r}
modelsummary(OrigEmoModels , fmt = 2, estimate = "{estimate}{stars}", statistic = c("std.error"), stars = c("*" = .05, "**" = .01, "***" = .001), gof_map = c("nobs", "r.squared", "adj.r.squared"), notes = "Note. * = .05, ** = .01, *** = .001", title = "Original Preregistered OLS Regressions Affect Valence")
```

## Combined Table w/o Ethnicity
```{r}
OrigEmoModels.5 <- list(OrigEmoInitial, OrigEmoInitial2.5,  OrigEmoInitial3.5, OrigEmoInitial4.5, OrigEmoInitial5a.5
)
```


```{r}
modelsummary(OrigEmoModels.5 , fmt = 2, estimate = "{estimate}{stars}", statistic = c("std.error"), stars = c("*" = .05, "**" = .01, "***" = .001), gof_map = c("nobs", "r.squared", "adj.r.squared"), notes = "Note. * = .05, ** = .01, *** = .001", title = "Original Preregistered OLS Regressions Affect Valence")
```
